entities.summary: Samuela Vatuniveivuke Kerevi is an Australian rugby union player currently playing for Urayasu D-Rocks in the Japan Rugby League One (JRLO). His usual position is centre. He previously played for the Queensland Reds in Super Rugby and has played for the Australian national team.
